summary: You produced an exemplary, technically sophisticated space mission design report for ZYZZsat. Your justification for coral bleaching monitoring, thorough analytical hand calculations, and seamless STK modeling demonstrated outstanding engineering rigor across all sections. Your self-critical appraisal in Section 3 was particularly mature. To push this work toward flight-ready standard, address the minor technical omissions in communication link budgets and ground station tracking capabilities.
next_steps: Formulate a formal RF link budget for the 50 Mbit/s X-band downlink in Section 2.4, calculating transmit power, path loss, G/T, and link margin.
Verify the tracking performance and slew-rate limits of the Mount Pleasant 12 m antenna for fast, low-elevation LEO passes.
Develop targeted risk-reduction and testing roadmaps for the engineering limitations identified in Section 3, specifically launcher flight heritage and fluid lensing.

To build on this level of technical depth, provide a formal RF link budget for the 50 Mbit/s X-band downlink and verify slew-rate constraints for the Mount Pleasant antenna during fast LEO passes.
criteria.C3: You achieved Accomplished by delivering a concise, evidence-based synthesis in Section 3. Your candid critical appraisal of engineering limitations—including launcher flight heritage, fluid lensing efficacy, and ground station modifications—showed mature engineering judgment. To further elevate future project conclusions, consider proposing targeted risk-reduction test plans for the key uncertainties identified.
criteria.C4: You achieved Accomplished with a polished, logically structured report. Your Executive Summary was comprehensive, graphical and tabular data were clearly formatted, and IEEE references matched the bibliography accurately. Maintain this professional presentation by continuing to ensure all appendix data and configuration files are explicitly referenced within the main text.
